title.zh: 卷五十三 列傳第二十三 愍懷太子
title.raw: 卷五十三 列傳第二十三 愍懷太子 Volume 53 Biographies 23: Crown Prince Minhuai

units.zh: 愍懷太子
units.literal: Crown Prince Minhuai
units.idiomatic: Crown Prince Minhuai

units.zh: 湣懷太子遹，字熙祖，惠帝長子，母曰謝才人。
units.literal: Crown Prince Minhuai, Yu, courtesy name Xizu, was Emperor Hui's eldest son; his mother was Talented Lady Xie.
units.idiomatic: Crown Prince Minhuai, Yu, courtesy name Xizu, was Emperor Hui's eldest son; his mother was Talented Lady Xie.

units.zh: 幼而聰慧，武帝愛之，恆在左右。
units.literal: From childhood he was clever and bright; Emperor Wu loved him and kept him always at his side.
units.idiomatic: From childhood he was clever and bright; Emperor Wu loved him and kept him always at his side.

units.zh: 初，賈后母郭槐欲以韓壽女為太子妃，太子亦欲婚韓氏以自固。
units.literal: Earlier Empress Jia's mother Guo Huai had wished to take Han Shou's daughter as crown princess; the crown prince also wished to marry the Hans to strengthen himself.
units.idiomatic: Earlier, Empress Jia's mother, Guo Huai, had wanted Han Shou's daughter to become crown princess. The crown prince also hoped that marrying into the Han family would strengthen his position.

units.zh: 而壽妻賈午及後皆不聽，而為太子聘王衍小女惠風。
units.literal: But Han Shou's wife Jia Wu and the empress both refused and instead betrothed the crown prince to Wang Yan's younger daughter Huifeng.
units.idiomatic: But Han Shou's wife Jia Wu and the empress both refused, and instead betrothed the crown prince to Wang Yan's younger daughter Huifeng.

units.zh: 太子聞衍長女美，而賈后為謐聘之，心不能平，頗以為言。
units.literal: The crown prince heard Wang's elder daughter was beautiful while the empress betrothed her to Jia Mi; his heart could not rest easy and he spoke of it often.
units.idiomatic: The crown prince heard Wang's elder daughter was beautiful while the empress betrothed her to Jia Mi; his heart could not rest easy and he spoke of it often.

units.zh: 謐嘗與太子圍棋，爭道，成都王穎見而訶謐，謐意愈不平，因此譖太子于後曰：「太子廣買田業，多畜私財以結小人者，為賈氏故也。
units.literal: Once Mi played go with the crown prince and they quarreled over the move; Ying, Prince of Chengdu, saw and rebuked Mi; Mi grew more resentful and therefore slandered the crown prince to the empress: 'The crown prince buys fields wholesale, hoards private wealth, and courts petty men—all because of the Jia clan.
units.idiomatic: Once while playing go with the crown prince Mi quarreled over a move; Ying, Prince of Chengdu, saw and rebuked Mi; Mi grew more resentful and slandered the crown prince to the empress: "The crown prince buys fields wholesale, hoards private wealth, and courts petty men—all because of the Jia clan.

units.zh: 沙門，太子小字也。
units.literal: 'Shamen' was the crown prince's childhood byname.
units.idiomatic: 'Shamen' was the crown prince's childhood byname.

units.zh: 初，太子之廢也，妃父王衍表請離婚。
units.literal: When the crown prince was first deposed, his father-in-law Wang Yan memorialized requesting divorce.
units.idiomatic: When the crown prince was first deposed, his father-in-law Wang Yan memorialized requesting divorce.

units.zh: 太子至許，遺妃書曰：「鄙雖頑愚，心念為善，欲盡忠孝之節，無有惡逆之心。
units.literal: After the crown prince reached Xu he sent his consort a letter: 'Though I am coarse and foolish at heart I wished to do good and fulfill loyalty and filial piety—I harbored no rebellious evil.
units.idiomatic: After reaching Xu he sent his consort a letter: "Though I am coarse and foolish, at heart I wished to do good and fulfill loyalty and filial piety—I harbored no rebellious evil.

title.zh: 卷三十一 列傳第二十五 袁昂 子君正
title.raw: 卷三十一 列傳第二十五 袁昂 子君正 Volume 31: Yuan Ang; Yuan Junzheng

units.zh: 梁書卷第三十一 列傳第二十五
units.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 31, Biographies 25
units.idiomatic: Book of Liang, Volume 31, Biographies 25

units.zh: 袁昂 子君正
units.literal: Yuan Ang; [his son] Yuan Junzheng
units.idiomatic: Yuan Ang; Yuan Junzheng

units.zh: 袁昂字千里，陳郡陽夏人。
units.literal: Yuan Ang, styled Qianli, was a native of Yangxia in Chen commandery.
units.idiomatic: Yuan Ang, styled Qianli, came from Yangxia in Chen commandery.

units.zh: 服闋，除右軍邵陵王長史，俄遷御史中丞。
units.literal: When mourning ended he was appointed Chief Clerk to the Prince of Shaoling, General of the Right Army, and soon promoted to Imperial Censor.
units.idiomatic: When his mourning ended he was made chief clerk to the Prince of Shaoling, General of the Right Army, and soon afterward promoted to imperial censor.

units.zh: 時尚書令王晏弟詡爲廣州，多納賕貨，昂依事劾奏，不憚權豪，當時號爲正直。
units.literal: At the time the younger brother of the Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Yan, Xu, was in Guangzhou and took many bribes; Ang impeached him according to the facts, not fearing the powerful, and at the time was called upright.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan's younger brother Xu was then in Guangzhou and took heavy bribes; Ang impeached him on the facts without fear of the powerful, and men of the day called him upright.

units.zh: 出爲豫章內史，丁所生母憂去職。
units.literal: He went out as Internal Administrator of Yuzhang and left office on the death of his biological mother.
units.idiomatic: He was sent out as internal administrator of Yuzhang and left office when his birth mother died.

title.zh: 卷一百〇二 漢書4: 隱帝本紀中
title.en: Volume 102 Book of Later Jin 4: Emperor Yin Annals 2
title.raw: 卷一百〇二 漢書4: 隱帝本紀中 Volume 102 Book of Later Jin 4: Emperor Yin Annals 2

units.zh: 乾祐二年春正月乙巳朔，制曰：
units.literal: In spring, the first month of the second year of Qianyou, on the first day of the month, yisi, an edict proclaimed:
units.idiomatic: In spring of the second year of Qianyou, on the first day, yisi, of the first month, an imperial edict proclaimed:

units.zh: 朕以渺躬，獲纘洪緒，念守器承祧之重，懷臨深履薄之憂。
units.literal: I, with my slight person, have obtained succession to the great line, mindful of the heavy charge of guarding the vessel of state and maintaining the ancestral sacrifices, and harboring the anxiety of one standing on the brink over deep water and treading on thin ice.
units.idiomatic: With my slight person I have succeeded to the great succession, mindful of the heavy charge of guarding the vessel of state and maintaining the ancestral line, and filled with the anxiety of one standing on the brink over deep water and treading on thin ice.

units.zh: 屬以天道猶艱，王室多故，天降重戾，國有大喪，奸臣樂禍以圖危，群寇幸災而伺隙，力役未息，兵革方殷。
units.literal: Just then Heaven's way was still arduous, the royal house had many troubles, Heaven sent down heavy calamity, the state had a great bereavement, treacherous ministers rejoiced in disaster to plot peril, bandits in multitudes welcomed calamity to watch for openings, corvée labor had not ceased, and arms were at their height.
units.idiomatic: Just then Heaven's way remained arduous and the royal house met with many troubles; Heaven sent down great calamity and the state suffered a great bereavement. Treacherous ministers rejoiced in disaster to plot peril, while bandits in multitudes welcomed calamity to watch for openings. Corvée labor had not ceased, and war was at its height.

units.zh: 西京奏，洛水溢岸。
units.literal: The Western Capital reported that the Luo River overflowed its banks.
units.idiomatic: The Western Capital reported that the Luo River had overflowed its banks.

units.zh: 乙丑，晉州王晏、同州張彥赟、邠州侯章、涇州史懿、滄州王景、延州高允權並加檢校太師。
units.literal: On yichou, Jin Prefecture Wang Yan, Tong Prefecture Zhang Yanyun, Bin Prefecture Hou Zhang, Jing Prefecture Shi Yi, Cang Prefecture Wang Jing, and Yan Prefecture Gao Yunquan were all given the additional title of Acting Grand Tutor.
units.idiomatic: On yichou, Wang Yan of Jin Prefecture, Zhang Yanyun of Tong Prefecture, Hou Zhang of Bin Prefecture, Shi Yi of Jing Prefecture, Wang Jing of Cang Prefecture, and Gao Yunquan of Yan Prefecture were all given the additional title of Acting Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 冬十月庚午朔，契丹入寇。
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day of the month, gengwu, the Khitan invaded.
units.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day, gengwu, the Khitan invaded.

title.zh: 吏部侍郎
尚書右丞
卷八十一 晉書7: 少帝本紀一
title.en: Volume 81 Book of Later Jin 7: Emperor Shao 1
title.raw: 卷八十一 晉書7: 少帝本紀一 Volume 81 Book of Later Jin 7: Emperor Shao 1

units.zh: 少帝，名重貴，高祖之從子也。
units.literal: The Young Emperor, named Chonggui, was a paternal nephew of Gaozu.
units.idiomatic: Emperor Shao, whose personal name was Chonggui, was a paternal nephew of Gaozu.

units.zh: 考諱敬儒，母安氏，以唐天祐十一年六月二十七日生帝於太原汾陽裏。
units.literal: His deceased father was taboo-named Jingru; his mother was the An clan. On the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month of the eleventh year of Tang Tianyou, the Emperor was born at Fenyang Lane in Taiyuan.
units.idiomatic: His father's posthumous name was Jingru, and his mother was Lady An. He was born on the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month of Tianyou 11 (914) at Fenyang Lane in Taiyuan.

units.zh: 敬儒嘗為後唐莊宗騎將，早薨，高祖以帝為子。
units.literal: Jingru had once served as a cavalry general under Later Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong and died young; Gaozu took the Emperor as his own son.
units.idiomatic: Jingru had once served as a cavalry general under Emperor Zhuangzong of Later Tang and died young, whereupon Gaozu adopted the boy as his son.

units.zh: 己卯，分命朝臣詣寺觀禱雨。
units.literal: On jimao, court ministers were separately ordered to go to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.
units.idiomatic: On jimao, court ministers were dispatched separately to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.

units.zh: 辛巳，兩浙節度使吳越國王錢宏佐、福建節度使王延羲，並加食邑，仍改賜功臣名號。
units.literal: On xinsi, Qian Hongzuo, King of Wuyue and military governor of the Two Zhes, and Wang Yanxi, military governor of Fujian, were both given increased fiefs and were granted new honorary titles of meritorious service.
units.idiomatic: On xinsi, Qian Hongzuo, King of Wuyue and military governor of the Two Zhes, and Wang Yanxi, military governor of Fujian, were both given increased fiefs and granted new honorary titles of meritorious service.

units.zh: 癸未，帝御乾明門，觀襄州行營都部署高行周、都監張從恩等獻俘馘。
units.literal: On guiwei, the Emperor held court at the Gate of Heavenly Brightness to observe Gao Xingzhou, overall commander of the Xiang Prefecture field headquarters, Zhang Cong'en, field supervisor, and others present captives and severed heads.
units.idiomatic: On guiwei, the Emperor held court at the Gate of Heavenly Brightness to observe Gao Xingzhou, overall commander of the Xiang Prefecture field headquarters, Zhang Cong'en, field supervisor, and others present captives and severed heads.

units.zh: 仍令所司擇日冊命。
units.literal: The responsible offices were further ordered to choose a day for the investiture ceremony.
units.idiomatic: The responsible offices were further ordered to choose a day for the investiture ceremony.

units.zh: 辛卯，以御史中丞王易簡為尚書左丞，以禮部侍郎張允為御史中丞，以中書舍人吳承範為禮部侍郎，以吏部侍郎王延為尚書右丞，以尚書右丞王松為吏部侍郎，以兵部侍郎張昭遠為吏部侍郎，以戶部侍郎呂琦為兵部侍郎，以刑部侍郎韋勛為戶部侍郎，以工部侍郎李詳為刑部侍郎。
units.literal: On xinmao, Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian was made Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Yun was made Vice Censor-in-Chief; Secretariat Drafting Secretary Wu Chengfang was made Vice Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Yan was made Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Song was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of War Zhang Zhaoyuan was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of Revenue Lü Qi was made Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of Punishments Wei Xun was made Vice Minister of Revenue; and Vice Minister of Works Li Xiang was made Vice Minister of Punishments.
units.idiomatic: On xinmao, Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian was made Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Yun was made Vice Censor-in-Chief; Secretariat Drafting Secretary Wu Chengfang was made Vice Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Yan was made Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Song was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of War Zhang Zhaoyuan was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of Revenue Lü Qi was made Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of Punishments Wei Xun was made Vice Minister of Revenue; and Vice Minister of Works Li Xiang was made Vice Minister of Punishments.

units.zh: 癸巳，命宰臣等分詣寺觀禱雨。
units.literal: On guisi, the chief councilors and others were ordered to go separately to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.
units.idiomatic: On guisi, the chief councilors and others were ordered to go separately to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.

title.en: Volume 286 Biographies 45: Lu Zongdao, Xue Kui, Wang Shu, Cai Qi
title.raw: 卷二百八十六 列傳第四十五 魯宗道 薛奎 王曙 蔡齊 Volume 286 Biographies 45: Lu Zongdao, Xue Kui, Wang Shu, Cai Qi

units.zh: 魯宗道
units.literal: Lu Zongdao
units.idiomatic: Lu Zongdao

units.zh: 魯宗道，字貫之，亳州譙人。
units.literal: Lu Zongdao, styled Guanzhi, was a native of Qiao in Bozhou.
units.idiomatic: Lu Zongdao, whose courtesy name was Guanzhi, came from Qiao in Bozhou.

units.zh: 少孤，鞠於外家。
units.literal: Orphaned in youth, he was reared in his maternal kin's household.
units.idiomatic: He lost his parents while still young and was brought up in the home of his mother's family.

units.zh: 適奎始生，撫其首曰：“是子必至公輔。”
units.literal: Just as Kui was born, he stroked the child's head and said: "This boy will surely reach the rank of chief minister."
units.idiomatic: Just as Kui was born, he stroked the infant's head and said: "This child will surely rise to chief minister."

units.zh: 奎舉進士，為州第一，乃推與裏人王嚴，而處嚴下。
units.literal: Kui passed the jinshi examination and ranked first in the prefecture, yet yielded the place to his fellow townsman Wang Yan and placed himself below Yan.
units.idiomatic: Kui took the jinshi examination and ranked first in the prefecture, yet yielded first place to his fellow townsman Wang Yan and placed himself below him.

units.zh: 進士及第，為隰州軍事推官。
units.literal: Having passed the jinshi examination, he became military judicial officer of Xizhou.
units.idiomatic: After passing the jinshi examination, he became military judicial officer of Xizhou.

title.zh: 西京留守
卷一百十四 周書5: 世宗本紀一
title.en: Volume 114 Book of Later Zhou 16: Shizong Annals 1
title.raw: 卷一百十四 周書5: 世宗本紀一 Volume 114 Book of Later Zhou 16: Shizong Annals 1

units.zh: 世宗睿武孝文皇帝，諱榮，太祖之養子，蓋聖穆皇后之侄也。
units.literal: The Emperor Shizong, posthumously titled Ruiwu Xiaowen, whose personal name was Rong, was the adopted son of Taizu and was in fact a nephew of Empress Shengmu.
units.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong, posthumously known as Ruiwu Xiaowen, bore the personal name Rong. He was Taizu's adopted son and a nephew of Empress Shengmu.

units.zh: 本姓柴氏，父守禮，太子少保致仕。
units.literal: His original surname was the Chai clan; his father was Shouli, who had retired as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
units.idiomatic: He was born into the Chai family. His father Shouli had retired from the post of Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 〈（《隆平集》：柴翁者，嘗獨居室，人以為司冥事。
units.literal: (The Longpingji states: There was an Old Man Chai who once lived alone in his room, and people thought he dealt with matters of the underworld.
units.idiomatic: (According to the Longpingji, an elder of the Chai clan once lived alone in his room, and people believed he had dealings with the realm of the dead.

units.zh: 庚辰，幸南莊。
units.literal: On gengchen, the Emperor visited the South Manor.
units.idiomatic: On gengchen the emperor visited the South Manor.

units.zh: 辛巳，荊南節度使、南平王高保融加守中書令，夏州節度使、西平王李彜興加守太保，西京留守武行德、徐州王晏、鄧州侯章並加兼中書令。
units.literal: On xinsi, Gao Baorong, military governor of Jingnan and Prince of Nanping, was advanced to Defender Councilor; Li Yixing, military governor of Xiazhou and Prince of Xiping, was advanced to Defender Grand Guardian; Wu Xingde, Western Capital resident defender, Wang Yan of Xuzhou, and Hou Zhang of Dengzhou were all additionally made Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
units.idiomatic: On xinsi Jingnan military governor and Prince of Nanping Gao Baorong was advanced to Defender Councilor; Xiazhou military governor and Prince of Xiping Li Yixing was advanced to Defender Grand Guardian; and Western Capital defender Wu Xingde, Xuzhou's Wang Yan, and Dengzhou's Hou Zhang were all additionally made councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

units.zh: 癸未，湖南王進逵加兼中書令；
units.literal: On guimao, Wang Jinkui of Hunan was additionally made Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery;
units.idiomatic: On guimao Hunan's Wang Jinkui was additionally made councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery;

units.zh: 冬十月甲辰，左羽林大將軍孟漢卿賜死，坐監納厚取耗餘也。
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiachen, Meng Hanqing, Major General of the Left Feathered Forest, was granted death for supervising collection and taking a heavy surplus in collection.
units.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen Left Feathered Forest Major General Meng Hanqing was ordered to take his own life for skimming excess grain while supervising tax collection.

units.zh: 丙午，以安州節度使李洪義為青州節度使，以貝州節度使王饒為相州節度使，以徐州節度使王晏為西京留守，以西京留守武行德為徐州節度使。
units.literal: On bingwu, Li Hongyi, military governor of Anzhou, was made military governor of Qingzhou; Wang Rao, military governor of Beizhou, was made military governor of Xiangzhou; Wang Yan, military governor of Xuzhou, was made Western Capital resident defender; Wu Xingde, Western Capital resident defender, was made military governor of Xuzhou.
units.idiomatic: On bingwu Anzhou military governor Li Hongyi was moved to Qingzhou; Beizhou military governor Wang Rao to Xiangzhou; Xuzhou military governor Wang Yan to Western Capital defender; and Western Capital defender Wu Xingde to Xuzhou military governor.

units.zh: 戊申，以龍捷左廂都指揮使、泗州防禦使韓令坤為洋州節度使，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使；
units.literal: On wushen, Han Lingkun, commander of the Dragon Swift Left Wing and defense commissioner of Sizhou, was made military governor of Yangzhou and appointed commander-in-chief of the palace guard cavalry;
units.idiomatic: On wushen Dragon Swift Left Wing commander and Sizhou defense commissioner Han Lingkun was made Yangzhou military governor and appointed commander-in-chief of the palace guard cavalry;

label.en: Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent

title.zh: 卷八十四 晉書10: 少帝本紀四
title.en: Volume 84 Book of Later Jin 10: Emperor Shao 3
title.raw: 卷八十四 晉書10: 少帝本紀四 Volume 84 Book of Later Jin 10: Emperor Shao 3

units.zh: 開運二年夏五月丙申朔，帝御崇元殿受朝，大赦天下。
units.literal: In the second year of Kaiyun, on the first day bingshen of the fifth summer month, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall to receive court homage and proclaimed a general amnesty for all under Heaven.
units.idiomatic: In Kaiyun 2, on the first day bingshen of the fifth summer month, the emperor held court at Chongyuan Hall, received homage, and proclaimed a general amnesty.

units.zh: 丁酉，以右衛上將軍馬萬為左金吾上將軍致仕。
units.literal: On dingyou, Ma Wan, General of the Right Guard, was made retired General of the Left Golden Chancellery.
units.idiomatic: On dingyou Ma Wan, General of the Right Guard, was retired as General of the Left Golden Chancellery.

units.zh: 戊戌，陜州節度使宋彥筠移鎮鄧州，澶州節度使何建移鎮河陽。
units.literal: On wuxu, Song Yanyun, military commissioner of Shaan Prefecture, was transferred to Deng Prefecture, and He Jian, military commissioner of Chan Prefecture, was transferred to Heyang.
units.idiomatic: On wuxu Song Yanyun moved from Shaan to Deng Prefecture, and He Jian from Chan to Heyang.

units.zh: 冬十月戊寅，以河陽節度使何建為涇州節度使，以許州節度使李從溫為河陽節度使，以前鄭州節度使石赟為曹州節度使。
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on wuyin, He Jian, military commissioner of Heyang, was made military commissioner of Jing Prefecture; Li Congwen, military commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Heyang; Shi Yun, former military commissioner of Zheng Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Cao Prefecture.
units.idiomatic: On wuyin of the tenth winter month He Jian moved from Heyang to Jing, Li Congwen from Xu to Heyang, and former Zheng commissioner Shi Yun to Cao.

units.zh: 庚午，遣使太子賓客羅周嶽、使副太子右庶子王延濟冊兩浙節度使錢宏佐為守太尉。
units.literal: On gengwu, envoys were dispatched: chief envoy Luo Zhouyue, Mentor of the Heir Apparent, and deputy envoy Wang Yanji, Right Vice Mentor of the Heir Apparent, to invest Qian Hongzuo, military commissioner of the Two Zhes, as Defender of Grand Marshal.
units.idiomatic: On gengwu chief envoy Luo Zhouyue and deputy Wang Yanji were sent to invest Two-Zhe commissioner Qian Hongzuo as Defender of Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 辛未，右金吾衛上將軍楊彥詢卒，贈太子太師。
units.literal: On xinwei, Yang Yanxun, General of the Right Golden Chancellery Guard, died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
units.idiomatic: On xinwei Yang Yanxun, General of the Right Golden Chancellery Guard, died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 詔李守貞為北面行營都部署，滑州皇甫遇為副，相州張彥澤充馬軍都指揮使，定州李殷充步軍都指揮使。
units.literal: An edict made Li Shouzhen overall commander of the Northern Circuit field headquarters, Huangfu Yu of Hua Prefecture deputy, Zhang Yanze of Xiang Prefecture commander of the cavalry, and Li Yin of Ding Prefecture commander of the infantry.
units.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen was made northern commander, Huangfu Yu of Hua deputy, Zhang Yanze of Xiang cavalry commander, and Li Yin of Ding infantry commander.

units.zh: 七月壬辰，以禮部尚書王延為刑部尚書，以工部尚書王松為禮部尚書，以太常卿龍敏為工部尚書，以左丞李慎儀為太常卿，以吏部侍郎張昭遠為左丞，以右丞李詳為吏部侍郎，以前義州刺史李玘為右丞。
units.literal: In the seventh month, on renchen, Wang Yan, Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Justice; Wang Song, Minister of Works, was made Minister of Rites; Long Min, Director of Ceremonies, was made Minister of Works; Li Shenyi, Left Vice Director, was made Director of Ceremonies; Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of the Civil Office, was made Left Vice Director; Li Xiang, Right Vice Director, was made Vice Minister of the Civil Office; Li Qi, former prefect of Yi Prefecture, was made Right Vice Director.
units.idiomatic: On renchen of the seventh month Wang Yan moved to Justice, Wang Song to Rites, Long Min to Works, Li Shenyi to Ceremonies, Zhang Zhaoyuan to Left Vice Director, Li Xiang to Civil Vice Minister, and former Yi prefect Li Qi to Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 前晉昌軍節度使安彥威薨，輟朝，贈太師。
units.literal: An Yanwei, former military commissioner of the Jinchang Army, died; court audiences were suspended, and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
units.idiomatic: Former Jinchang commissioner An Yanwei died; audiences were suspended and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 乙巳，詔安審琦率兵赴鄴都，皇甫遇赴相州。
units.literal: On yisi, an edict ordered An Shenqi to lead troops to Ye and Huangfu Yu to Xiang Prefecture.
units.idiomatic: On yisi An Shenqi was ordered to Ye and Huangfu Yu to Xiang.

units.zh: 丙午，以太子少保楊凝式為太子少傅，以刑部尚書王延為太子少保，前潁州團練使竇貞固為刑部尚書。
units.literal: On bingwu, Yang Ningshi, Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Senior Mentor; Wang Yan, Minister of Justice, was made Junior Mentor; Dou Zhengu, former training commissioner of Ying Prefecture, was made Minister of Justice.
units.idiomatic: On bingwu Yang Ningshi became Senior Mentor, Wang Yan Junior Mentor, and former Ying commissioner Dou Zhengu Minister of Justice.

units.zh: 是月，河南、河北、關西諸州奏，大水霖雨不止，溝河泛濫，水入城郭及損害秋稼。
units.literal: That month Henan, Hebei, and the western passes reported that great floods and unending rains made ditches and rivers overflow, water entered cities, and the autumn grain was harmed.
units.idiomatic: That month Henan, Hebei, and the western passes reported floods, endless rain, cities inundated, and crops ruined.

title.zh: 卷十一 周本紀第十一: 太祖
title.raw: 卷十一 周本紀第十一: 太祖 Volume 11 Later Zhou Annals 2: Taizu

units.zh: 太祖聖神恭肅文武孝皇帝，姓郭氏，邢州堯山人也。
units.literal: Taizu, the Sagely, Divine, Reverent, Solemn, Civil, Martial, Filial Emperor—surname Guo, a native of Yaoshan in Xingzhou.
units.idiomatic: Taizu, temple name the Sagely, Divine, Reverent, Solemn, Civil, Martial, Filial Emperor, was of the Guo clan and came from Yaoshan in Xingzhou.

units.zh: 父簡，事晉為順州刺史。
units.literal: His father Jian served Jin as prefect of Shunzhou.
units.idiomatic: His father Jian had served the Jin as prefect of Shunzhou.

units.zh: 劉仁恭攻破順州，簡見殺，子威少孤，依潞州人常氏。
units.literal: Liu Rengong took Shunzhou; Jian was killed. Young son Wei was left alone and relied on the Chang clan of Luzhou.
units.idiomatic: When Liu Rengong seized Shunzhou, Jian was killed. Wei was still a boy and, orphaned, was taken in by the Chang family of Luzhou.

units.zh: 庚子，至自兗州。
units.literal: On gengzi he returned from Yanzhou.
units.idiomatic: On gengzi he came back from Yanzhou.

units.zh: 秋九月乙丑，太僕少卿王演使於高麗。
units.literal: On yichou in the ninth month of autumn, Palace Stud Vice Director Wang Yan was sent as envoy to Goryeo.
units.idiomatic: On yichou in the ninth month Wang Yan, vice director of the Palace Stud, was sent to Goryeo.

units.zh: 契丹寇邊。
units.literal: The Khitans raided the frontier.
units.idiomatic: The Khitans raided the border.

title.zh: 卷三 帝紀第三 世祖武帝
title.raw: 卷三 帝紀第三 世祖武帝 Volume 3 Annals 3: Emperor Wu

units.zh: 武皇帝諱炎，字安世，文帝長子也。
units.literal: The Martial Emperor's taboo name was Yan, his style name Anshi; he was the eldest son of Emperor Wen.
units.idiomatic: The emperor honored posthumously as Wu bore the personal name Yan and the courtesy name Anshi; he was the firstborn son of Emperor Wen (Sima Zhao).

units.zh: 寬惠仁厚，沈深有度量。
units.literal: He was generous, kind, and humane in his magnanimity, deep and reserved, with breadth of mind.
units.idiomatic: Broad-minded, humane, and gentle by nature, he was grave and self-contained, with the measured bearing of a true ruler.

units.zh: 魏嘉平中，封北平亭侯，歷給事中、奉車都尉、中壘將軍，加散騎常侍，累遷中護軍、假節。
units.literal: In the Jiaping era of Wei he was enfeoffed as marquis of Beipingting, then served successively as gentleman in attendance, commandant of the imperial chariots, general of the central rampart, with additional appointment as regular palace attendant of cavalier, and was repeatedly promoted to central protector with plenary authority.
units.idiomatic: During Wei’s Jiaping years he received the Beipingting marquisate and rose through a string of palace and guard posts—gentleman in attendance, commandant of the imperial chariots, general of the central rampart, cavalier attendant-in-ordinary—until he became central protector, bearing the credential staff.

units.zh: 壬戌，濬又克夷道樂鄉城，殺夷道監陸晏、水軍都督陸景。
units.literal: On the day renxu Jun further took Yidao and Lexiang towns, killing Yidao intendant Lu Yan and commander of the navy Lu Jing.
units.idiomatic: Renxu: Wang Jun pushed to Yidao and Lexiang and killed Lu Yan and Lu Jing.

units.zh: 甲戌，杜預克江陵，斬吳江陵督伍延；
units.literal: On the day jiaxu Du Yu took Jiangling and beheaded Wu’s Jiangling commander Wu Yan;
units.idiomatic: Jiaxu: Du Yu entered Jiangling and executed Wu Yan;

units.zh: 平南將軍胡奮克江安。
units.literal: General who pacifies the south Hu Fen took Jiang’an.
units.idiomatic: Hu Fen secured Jiang’an.

units.zh: 按：本書杜預傳、冊府元龜以下簡稱冊府三五〇「留憲」作「劉憲」。
units.literal: Comment: Du Yu’s biography in this book and Cefu yuangui 350 write the name as Liu Xian with the surname Liu, whereas the annals write Liu Xian with the graph liu meaning “to stay.”
units.idiomatic: Du Yu’s memoir and the Cefu quotation spell the commander’s name as Liu Xian; the annals use the homophone “stay” for the surname syllable.

units.zh: 斬吳江陵都督伍延 「伍延」，各本皆作「王延」。
units.literal: Regarding beheading Wu’s Jiangling commander Wu Yan: editions all write Wang Yan instead of Wu Yan.
units.idiomatic: For beheading Wu’s Jiangling commander Wu Yan, editions all write "Wang Yan" for "Wu Yan."

units.zh: 按：本書杜預傳、吳志孫皓傳、冊府一二一、通鑑八一皆作「伍延」，今據改。
units.literal: Comment: Du Yu’s biography, Wu zhi, Cefu yuangui 121, and Zizhi tongjian 81 all have Wu Yan; emend accordingly.
units.idiomatic: Note: Du Yu’s biography in this book, Wu zhi, Sun Hao biography, Cefu 121, and Tongjian 81 all write "Wu Yan"; it is now corrected accordingly.

units.zh: 參周校及洪頤烜諸史考異。
units.literal: See Zhou’s collation and Hong Yixuan’s Zhu shi kaoyi.
units.idiomatic: See Zhou and Hong for discussion.

title.zh: 卷三十二 本紀第三十二 高宗九
title.raw: 卷三十二 本紀第三十二 高宗九 Volume 32 Annals 32: Gaozong 9

units.zh: 三十一年春正月甲戌朔，以日食，不受朝。
units.literal: Thirty-first year, spring, first month, day jiaxu new moon: because of a solar eclipse, court audience was not held.
units.idiomatic: Year 31, spring, jiaxu new moon: Gaozong canceled audience for the eclipse.

units.zh: 丁丑，雷。
units.literal: Day dingchou: thunder.
units.idiomatic: On dingchou, thunder rolled.

units.zh: 丁亥，免湖州增丁所輸絹。
units.literal: Day dinghai: the silk paid by Huzhou for added registered households was remitted.
units.idiomatic: On dinghai, Huzhou was freed from added-household silk levies.

units.zh: 乙未，行新造會子於淮、浙、湖北、京西諸州。
units.literal: Day yiwei: newly minted exchange notes were put into circulation in the Huai, Zhe, Hubei, and Jingxi prefectures.
units.idiomatic: On yiwei, new exchange notes circulated in the Huai, Zhe, Hubei, and Jingxi.

units.zh: 是月，金主亮徙都汴京，命其臣劉萼由唐、鄧瞰荊、襄，張中彥、王彥章據秦、鳳、窺巴、蜀，蘇保衡、完顏鄭家奴由海道趨兩浙。
units.literal: That month, the Jin ruler Hailing moved the capital to Bianjing; he ordered his minister Liu E from Tang and Deng to overlook Jing and Xiang; Zhang Zhongyan and Wang Yanchang to hold Qin and Feng and spy on Ba and Shu; Su Baoheng and Wanyan Zhengjianu by sea toward the two Zhes.
units.idiomatic: That month Hailing moved to Bianjing; Liu E threatened Jing and Xiang from Tang and Deng; Zhang Zhongyan and Wang Yanchang menaced Ba and Shu from Qin and Feng; Su Baoheng and Wanyan Zhengjianu sailed toward Zhe.

units.zh: 八月辛丑朔，忠義人魏勝復海州，李寶承制以勝知州事。
units.literal: Eighth month, day xinchou new moon: loyalist Wei Sheng recovered Haizhou; Li Bao, by provisional order, made Sheng prefect.
units.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinchou new moon: Wei Sheng retook Haizhou; Li Bao made him prefect.

units.zh: 丙辰，金主亮入廬州，王權自昭關遁，金人追至尉子橋，破敵軍統制姚興戰死，權退保和州。
units.literal: Day bingchen: the Jin ruler Hailing entered Luzhou; Wang Quan fled from Zhaoguan; the Jin pursued to Weizi Bridge; Break-the-Enemy controller Yao Xing died fighting; Quan fell back to defend Hezhou.
units.idiomatic: On bingchen, Hailing entered Luzhou; Wang Quan fled Zhaoguan; at Weizi Bridge Yao Xing fell; Quan held Hezhou.

units.zh: 金州都統制王彥遣統制任天錫出洵陽，復豐陽縣。
units.literal: Jinzhou overall commander Wang Yan sent controller Ren Tiansi out of Xunyang and recovered Fengyang county.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan's Ren Tiansi left Xunyang and retook Fengyang.

units.zh: 丁巳，帝聞王權敗，召楊存中同宰執議於內殿，陳康伯贊帝定議親征。
units.literal: Day dingsi: the Emperor, hearing Wang Quan was defeated, summoned Yang Cunzhong with the chief ministers to discuss in the inner hall; Chen Kangbo praised the Emperor for fixing on campaigning in person.
units.idiomatic: On dingsi, hearing of Wang Quan's defeat, Gaozong called Yang Cunzhong and the councilors within; Chen Kangbo praised his resolve to take the field.

units.zh: 金主亮焚其舟而去。
units.literal: The Jin ruler Hailing burned his boats and left.
units.idiomatic: Hailing burned his boats and withdrew.

units.zh: 戊寅，王彥遣將楊堅復欒川縣。
units.literal: Day wuyin: Wang Yan sent General Yang Jian to recover Luanchuan county.
units.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wang Yan's Yang Jian retook Luanchuan.

units.zh: 己卯，以湯思退為行宮留守。
units.literal: Day jimao: Tang Situi was made mobile-court resident.
units.idiomatic: On jimao, Tang Situi was made mobile-court resident.

units.zh: 復犯襄陽，統制官李勝等拒卻之，復通化軍。
units.literal: They again attacked Xiangyang; controller Li Sheng and others repelled them and restored Tonghua army.
units.idiomatic: They struck Xiangyang again; controller Li Sheng and others drove them off and restored Tonghua army.

units.zh: 王彥遣將楊堅、黨清至西京長水縣及金人戰，敗之。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent generals Yang Jian and Dang Qing to Changshui county west of the Western Capital and fought the Jin, defeating them.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent Yang Jian and Dang Qing to Changshui west of the Western Capital, fought the Jin, and won.

units.zh: 庚寅，復長水縣。
units.literal: Day gengyin: Changshui county was restored.
units.idiomatic: On gengyin, Changshui county was restored.

units.zh: 十二月己亥朔，趙撙夜襲蔡州，復入其城。
units.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai new moon: Zhao Zong by night raided Cai prefecture and re-entered its walls.
units.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jihai new moon: Zhao Zong night-raided Cai prefecture and re-entered the city.

units.zh: 王彥遣兵復福昌縣。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent troops to recover Fuchang county.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent troops to retake Fuchang county.

units.zh: 庚子，楊存中及虞允文渡江至瓜州察金兵。
units.literal: Day gengzi: Yang Cunzhong and Yu Yunwen crossed the river to Guazhou to inspect Jin troops.
units.idiomatic: On gengzi, Yang Cunzhong and Yu Yunwen crossed to Guazhou to scout the Jin.

units.zh: 金統軍劉萼聞茨湖敗，亦退師。
units.literal: Jin overall commander Liu E, hearing of the defeat at Cihu, also withdrew his army.
units.idiomatic: Jin commander Liu E, hearing of Cihu's defeat, also withdrew.

units.zh: 王彥遣將閻玘復澠池縣。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent general Yan Qi to recover Mianchi county.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent Yan Qi to retake Mianchi county.

units.zh: 壬寅，天有白氣。
units.literal: Day renyin: white vapor appeared in the sky.
units.idiomatic: On renyin, white vapor appeared in the sky.

units.zh: 戊午，復引兵來攻，撙又敗之，金兵遁去。
units.literal: Day wuwu: they came again; Zong again defeated them and the Jin fled.
units.idiomatic: On wuwu, they returned; Zong defeated them again and the Jin fled.

units.zh: 王彥遣將馬貴斷河中南橋，金兵來攻，貴戰敗之。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent general Ma Gui to cut the south bridge on the Yellow River; the Jin came to attack and Gui defeated them.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent Ma Gui to cut the Yellow River's south bridge; the Jin attacked and Gui defeated them.

units.zh: 壬戌，詔軍士戰死者祿其家一年，傷重而死于營者半之。
units.literal: Day renxu: an edict granted one year's salary to families of soldiers killed in battle; half for those who died in camp of severe wounds.
units.idiomatic: On renxu, families of soldiers killed in battle received one year's salary; half for those who died in camp of severe wounds.

units.zh: 姚仲遣副將趙銓攻下鎮戎軍，金同知渭州秦弼及其子嵩來歸。
units.literal: Yao Zhong sent deputy Zhao Quan to take Zhenrong army; Jin acting Wei prefecture commissioner Qin Bi and his son Song came over.
units.idiomatic: Yao Zhong's deputy Zhao Quan took Zhenrong army; Jin acting Wei commissioner Qin Bi and his son Song defected.

units.zh: 王彥遣兵救陝州，遇金人於虢州東，敗之，金兵引去。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent troops to relieve Shan prefecture, met the Jin east of Guo prefecture, defeated them, and the Jin withdrew.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent relief to Shan, met the Jin east of Guo, defeated them, and the Jin withdrew.

units.zh: 丁卯，吳珙遣將復永安軍、永寧、福昌、長水三縣。
units.literal: Day dingmao: Wu Gong sent generals to recover Yong'an army and the three counties Yongning, Fuchang, and Changshui.
units.idiomatic: On dingmao, Wu Gong's generals retook Yong'an army and Yongning, Fuchang, and Changshui counties.

units.zh: 甲辰，罷扈從官吏賞典。
units.literal: Day jiachen: reward grants to officials of the imperial retinue were abolished.
units.idiomatic: On jiachen, reward grants to retinue officials were abolished.

units.zh: 乙巳，錄商、虢之功，加吳璘少傅、王彥為保平軍節度使。
units.literal: Day yisi: the merits at Shang and Guo were recorded; Wu Lin was advanced to junior mentor and Wang Yan was made Baoping military commissioner.
units.idiomatic: On yisi, merits at Shang and Guo were recorded; Wu Lin was made junior mentor and Wang Yan Baoping military commissioner.

units.zh: 戊申，吳璘復德順軍，又遣將嚴忠取環州。
units.literal: Day wushen: Wu Lin recovered Deshun army and also sent general Yan Zhong to take Huanzhou.
units.idiomatic: On wushen, Wu Lin recovered Deshun and sent Yan Zhong to take Huanzhou.

title.zh: 卷一百十一 周書2: 太祖本紀二
title.en: Volume 111 Book of Later Zhou 13: Taizu Annals 2
title.raw: 卷一百十一 周書2: 太祖本紀二 Volume 111 Book of Later Zhou 13: Taizu Annals 2

units.zh: 廣順元年春二月癸巳朔，以樞密副使、尚書戶部侍郎範質為兵部侍郎，依前充職；
units.literal: In the first year of Guangshun, on the new moon of the second month of spring, on the day guisi, Fan Zhi, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Minister of Revenue in the Ministry of Revenue, was appointed Vice Minister of War, continuing in his previous office;
units.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangshun, on the new moon of the second month of spring, on guisi day, Fan Zhi, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Minister of Revenue, was appointed Vice Minister of War while retaining his existing duties;

units.zh: 以陳州刺史、判三司李穀為戶部侍郎，判三司；
units.literal: Li Gu, Prefect of Chen prefecture and Commissioner of the Three Offices, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Commissioner of the Three Offices;
units.idiomatic: Li Gu, Prefect of Chen and Commissioner of the Three Offices, was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and continued as Commissioner of the Three Offices;

units.zh: 以右金吾大將軍、充街使翟光鄴為左千牛衛上將軍，充宣徽北院使；
units.literal: Zhai Guangye, General of the Right Golden Guard and Street Commissioner, was made General of the Left Thousand-Bull Guard and Commissioner of the North Bureau of the Palace Secretariat;
units.idiomatic: Zhai Guangye, General of the Right Golden Guard and Street Commissioner, was appointed General of the Left Thousand-Bull Guard and Commissioner of the North Bureau of the Palace Secretariat;

units.zh: 湘陰公夫人並骨肉在彼，仰差人安撫守護，勿令驚恐。」
units.literal: The lady of Duke of Xiangyin and her kin who are there—officials are ordered to send persons to reassure and protect them, and not to let them be frightened."
units.idiomatic: The Duchess of Xiangyin and her family who remain there are to be reassured and protected by dispatched officials, without alarm."

units.zh: 以右散騎常侍張煦、給事中王延藹並為左散騎常侍，以前大名府少尹李瓊為將作監，以前彰武軍節度使周密為太子太師致仕，以衛尉卿劉皞充漢隱帝山陵部署。
units.literal: Zhang Xu, Regular Attendant of the Right Cavalry, and Wang Yan'ai, Drafting Official in the Secretariat, were both made Regular Attendants of the Left Cavalry; the former Junior Prefect of Daming Fu Li Qiong was made Director of Palace Construction; the former Military Commissioner of the Zhangwu Army Zhou Mi was made retired Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; Liu Hao, Chamberlain for the Guards, was appointed to the arrangements for the mausoleum of Emperor Yin of Han.
units.idiomatic: Zhang Xu, Regular Attendant of the Right Cavalry, and Wang Yan'ai, Drafting Official, were both appointed Regular Attendants of the Left Cavalry; former Junior Prefect of Daming Li Qiong became Director of Palace Construction; former Military Commissioner of the Zhangwu Army Zhou Mi received retirement as Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; and Liu Hao, Chamberlain for the Guards, was placed in charge of arrangements for Hidden Emperor of Han's mausoleum.

units.zh: 丙子，以太子少保致仕王延為太子少傅，以戶部尚書致仕盧損、左驍衛上將軍致仕李肅並為太子少保，兵部尚書致仕韓昭允為尚書右僕射，太子太師致仕盧文紀為司空。
units.literal: On the day bingzi, Wang Yan, retired Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince, was made Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; Lu Sun, retired Minister of Revenue, and Li Su, retired General of the Left Swift Horse Guard, were both made Junior Guardians of the Crown Prince; Han Zhaoyun, retired Minister of War, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Lu Wenji, retired Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, was made Minister of Works.
units.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Wang Yan moved from retired Junior Guardian to Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; Lu Sun, retired Minister of Revenue, and Li Su, retired General of the Left Swift Horse Guard, both became Junior Guardians of the Crown Prince; Han Zhaoyun, retired Minister of War, became Right Vice Director of State Affairs; and Lu Wenji, retired Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, became Minister of Works.

units.zh: 自延而下，並依前致仕。
units.literal: From Yan downward, all continued in retirement as before.
units.idiomatic: From Yan downward, all remained in retirement as before.

units.zh: 故散騎常侍裴羽贈戶部尚書，故太子賓客蕭願贈禮部尚書，以司農卿致仕薛仁謙為鴻臚卿，以將作監致仕烏昭為太府卿，以太常少卿致仕王禧為少府監，以秘書少監致仕段颙為將作監。
units.literal: The late Regular Attendant Pei Yu was posthumously made Minister of Revenue; the late Advisor to the Crown Prince Xiao Yuan was posthumously made Minister of Rites; Xue Renqian, retired Director of the Court of the Imperial Granaries, was made Chamberlain for Dependencies; Wu Zhao, retired Director of Palace Construction, was made Chamberlain for the Imperial Household; Wang Xi, retired Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Director of the Palace Workshop; Duan Yong, retired Vice Director of the Palace Library, was made Director of Palace Construction.
units.idiomatic: The late Regular Attendant Pei Yu was posthumously created Minister of Revenue; the late Crown Prince's Advisor Xiao Yuan, Minister of Rites; Xue Renqian, retired Director of the Imperial Granaries, became Chamberlain for Dependencies; Wu Zhao, retired Director of Palace Construction, Chamberlain for the Imperial Household; Wang Xi, retired Vice Director of Imperial Sacrifices, Director of the Palace Workshop; and Duan Yong, retired Vice Director of the Palace Library, Director of Palace Construction.

title.zh: 卷八十 列傳第四十 孝武十四王
title.raw: 卷八十 列傳第四十 孝武十四王 Volume 80 Biographies 40: Xiaowu Shisi Wang

units.zh: 孝武帝二十八男：文穆皇后生廢帝子業、豫章王子尚，陳淑媛生晉安王子勛，阮容華生安陸王子綏，徐昭容生皇子子深，何淑儀生松滋侯子房，史昭華生臨海王子頊，殷貴妃生始平孝敬王子鸞，次永嘉王子仁，與皇子子深同生，何婕妤生皇子子鳳，謝昭容生始安王子真，江婕妤生皇子子玄，史昭儀生邵陵王子元，次齊敬王子羽，與始平孝敬王子鸞同生，江美人生皇子子衡，楊婕妤生淮南王子孟，次皇子子況，與皇子子玄同生，次南平王子產，與永嘉王子仁同生，次晉陵孝王子雲，次皇子子文，並與始平孝敬王子鸞同生，次廬陵王子輿，與淮南王子孟同生，次南海哀王子師，與始平孝敬王子鸞同生，次淮陽思王子霄，與皇子子玄同生，次皇子子雍，與始安王子真同生，次皇子子趨，與皇子子鳳同生，次皇子子期，與皇子子衡同生，次東平王子嗣，與始安王子真同生，杜容華生皇子子悅。
units.literal: Emperor Xiaowu had twenty-eight sons: Empress Wenmu bore the Deposed Emperor Ziye and Yuzhang Prince Zi Shang; Lady Chen bore Jin'an Prince Zi Xun; Ruan Ronghua bore Anlu Prince Zi Sui; Xu Zhaorong bore Prince Zi Shen; He Shuyi bore Songzi Marquis Zi Fang; Shi Zhaohua bore Linhai Prince Zi Xu; Noble Consort Yin bore Shiping Xiaojing Prince Zi Luan, next Yongjia Prince Zi Ren, born together with Prince Zi Shen; Lady He bore Prince Zi Feng; Xie Zhaorong bore Shi'an Prince Zi Zhen; Lady Jiang bore Prince Zi Xuan; Lady Shi bore Shaoling Prince Zi Yuan, next Qi Jing Prince Zi Yu, born together with Shiping Xiaojing Prince Zi Luan; Lady Jiang bore Prince Zi Heng; Lady Yang bore Huainan Prince Zi Meng, next Prince Zi Kuang, born together with Prince Zi Xuan, next Nanping Prince Zi Chan, born together with Yongjia Prince Zi Ren, next Jinling Xiao Prince Zi Yun, next Prince Zi Wen, all born together with Shiping Xiaojing Prince Zi Luan, next Luling Prince Zi Yu, born together with Huainan Prince Zi Meng, next Nanhai Ai Prince Zi Shi, born together with Shiping Xiaojing Prince Zi Luan, next Huaiyang Si Prince Zi Xiao, born together with Prince Zi Xuan, next Prince Zi Yong, born together with Shi'an Prince Zi Zhen, next Prince Zi Qu, born together with Prince Zi Feng, next Prince Zi Qi, born together with Prince Zi Heng, next Dongping Prince Zi Si, born together with Shi'an Prince Zi Zhen; Du Ronghua bore Prince Zi Yue.
units.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu had twenty-eight sons. Empress Wenmu bore the Deposed Emperor Ziye and Yuzhang Prince Zi Shang. Lady Chen bore Jin'an Prince Zi Xun. Ruan Ronghua bore Anlu Prince Zi Sui. Xu Zhaorong bore Prince Zi Shen. He Shuyi bore Songzi Marquis Zi Fang. Shi Zhaohua bore Linhai Prince Zi Xu. Noble Consort Yin bore Shiping Xiaojing Prince Zi Luan, then Yongjia Prince Zi Ren (twins with Prince Zi Shen). Lady He bore Prince Zi Feng. Xie Zhaorong bore Shi'an Prince Zi Zhen. Lady Jiang bore Prince Zi Xuan. Lady Shi bore Shaoling Prince Zi Yuan, then Qi Jing Prince Zi Yu (twins with Shiping Xiaojing Prince Zi Luan). Lady Jiang bore Prince Zi Heng. Lady Yang bore Huainan Prince Zi Meng, then Prince Zi Kuang (twins with Prince Zi Xuan), then Nanping Prince Zi Chan (twins with Yongjia Prince Zi Ren), then Jinling Xiao Prince Zi Yun and Prince Zi Wen (all twins with Shiping Xiaojing Prince Zi Luan), then Luling Prince Zi Yu (twins with Huainan Prince Zi Meng), then Nanhai Ai Prince Zi Shi (twins with Shiping Xiaojing Prince Zi Luan), then Huaiyang Si Prince Zi Xiao (twins with Prince Zi Xuan), then Prince Zi Yong (twins with Shi'an Prince Zi Zhen), then Prince Zi Qu (twins with Prince Zi Feng), then Prince Zi Qi (twins with Prince Zi Heng), then Dongping Prince Zi Si (twins with Shi'an Prince Zi Zhen). Du Ronghua bore Prince Zi Yue.

units.zh: 安陸王子綏、南平王子產、廬陵王子輿並出繼。
units.literal: Anlu Prince Zi Sui, Nanping Prince Zi Chan, and Luling Prince Zi Yu were all adopted out as heirs.
units.idiomatic: Anlu Prince Zi Sui, Nanping Prince Zi Chan, and Luling Prince Zi Yu were all given in adoption to continue other lines.

units.zh: 皇子子深、子鳳、子玄、子衡、子況、子文、子雍未封，早夭。
units.literal: Princes Zi Shen, Zi Feng, Zi Xuan, Zi Heng, Zi Kuang, Zi Wen, and Zi Yong received no fiefs and died young.
units.idiomatic: Princes Zi Shen, Zi Feng, Zi Xuan, Zi Heng, Zi Kuang, Zi Wen, and Zi Yong were never enfeoffed and died in childhood.

units.zh: 太宗遣衞將軍巴陵王休若督諸將吳喜等東討，戰無不捷，以次平定。
units.literal: Emperor Ming sent Guards General Prince of Baling Xiu Ruo to command the generals Wu Xi and others in an eastern campaign; in battle they were never unsuccessful, and the regions were pacified in succession.
units.idiomatic: Emperor Ming sent Guards General Prince of Baling Xiu Ruo to lead generals including Wu Xi in an eastern campaign. They won every battle and pacified the region step by step.

units.zh: 上虞令王晏起兵殺覬，囚子房，送還京都，上宥之，貶為松滋縣侯，食邑千戶。
units.literal: Magistrate of Shangyu Wang Yan raised troops, killed Xian, imprisoned Zi Fang, and sent him back to the capital; the Emperor pardoned him and demoted him to Marquis of Songzi county with a fief of one thousand households.
units.idiomatic: Shangyu Magistrate Wang Yan raised troops, killed Kong Xian, imprisoned Zi Fang, and sent him to the capital. The Emperor spared his life but demoted him to Marquis of Songzi with a fief of one thousand households.

units.zh: 司徒建安王休仁以子房兄弟終為禍難，勸上除之。
units.literal: Director of the Secretariat Prince of Jian'an Xiu Ren, considering that Zi Fang and his brothers would in the end bring calamity, urged the Emperor to eliminate them.
units.idiomatic: Director of the Secretariat Prince of Jian'an Xiu Ren argued that Zi Fang and his brothers would ultimately bring disaster and urged the Emperor to eliminate them.

title.zh: 卷九十九 漢書1: 高祖本紀上
title.en: Volume 99 Book of Later Jin 1: Gaozu Annals 1
title.raw: 卷九十九 漢書1: 高祖本紀上 Volume 99 Book of Later Jin 1: Gaozu Annals 1

units.zh: 高祖睿文聖武昭肅孝皇帝，姓劉氏，諱暠，本名知遠，及即位改今諱。
units.literal: Gaozu, the Sagely, Cultured, Sacred, Martial, Illustrious, and Solemnly Filial Emperor, bore the surname Liu; his taboo name was Gao; his original name was Zhiyuan, which upon his accession he changed to the present taboo name.
units.idiomatic: Gaozu, the Sagely, Cultured, Sacred, Martial, Illustrious, and Solemnly Filial Emperor, was of the Liu clan; his taboo name was Gao. He had been born Zhiyuan and took the present taboo name when he came to the throne.

units.zh: 其先本沙陀部人也。
units.literal: His ancestors were originally people of the Shatuo tribe.
units.idiomatic: His forebears were originally of the Shatuo tribe.

units.zh: 四代祖諱湍，帝有天下，追尊為明元皇帝，廟號文祖，陵曰懿陵；
units.literal: His fourth-generation ancestor was named Tuan; after the Emperor possessed All Under Heaven, he was posthumously honored as Emperor Mingyuan, with temple name Wenzu and tomb called Yiling;
units.idiomatic: His fourth-generation ancestor was named Tuan; once the emperor held the realm, Tuan was posthumously honored as Emperor Mingyuan, with the temple name Wenzu and the tomb Yiling;

units.zh: 自是群官三上箋，諸軍將吏、緇黃耆耋，相次迫請，教答允之。
units.literal: From then on the officials submitted memorials three times; military officers, monks and priests, and elders in succession pressed the request, and an edict in reply agreed.
units.idiomatic: Thereafter officials memorialized three times, and officers, clergy, and elders pressed him in turn until an edict in reply accepted.

units.zh: 庚午，陜府屯駐奉國指揮使趙暉、侯章、都頭王晏殺契丹監軍及副使劉願，暉自稱留後。
units.literal: On the day gengwu Zhao Hui, commander of the Fengguo army stationed at Shaan prefecture, Hou Zhang, and company head Wang Yan killed the Khitan military supervisor and vice commissioner Liu Yuan; Hui styled himself acting military governor.
units.idiomatic: On gengwu Zhao Hui of the Fengguo command at Shaan, Hou Zhang, and Wang Yan killed the Khitan supervisor and vice commissioner Liu Yuan; Hui declared himself acting military governor.

units.zh: 契丹因授暉陜州兵馬留後，侯章為本州馬步軍都指揮使，王晏為副都指揮使，暉等不受命。
units.literal: The Khitan thereupon appointed Hui acting military governor of Shaanzhou's forces, Hou Zhang commander of the prefecture's cavalry and infantry, and Wang Yan vice commander; Hui and the others did not accept the appointments.
units.idiomatic: The Khitan then appointed Hui acting military governor of Shaanzhou's forces, Hou Zhang commander of the prefecture's cavalry and infantry, and Wang Yan vice commander, but they refused the orders.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·王晏傳》：開運末，與本軍都校趙暉、忠衛都校侯章等戍陜州。
units.literal: (Song History, Biography of Wang Yan: At the end of Kaiyun he garrisoned Shaanzhou with the army commander Zhao Hui, the Zhongwei commander Hou Zhang, and others.
units.idiomatic: (Song History, Biography of Wang Yan: At the end of Kaiyun he was posted to Shaanzhou with Zhao Hui, commander of the main force, Hou Zhang of the Zhongwei guard, and others.

units.zh: 會契丹至汴，遣其將劉願據陜，恣行暴虐。
units.literal: It happened that the Khitan reached Bian and sent their general Liu Yuan to hold Shaan, who indulged in violence and cruelty.
units.idiomatic: When the Khitan reached Bian they sent Liu Yuan to hold Shaan, and he ravaged the people.

units.zh: 趙延壽於鎮州自稱權知國事。
units.literal: At Zhenzhou Zhao Yanshou styled himself acting administrator of state affairs.
units.idiomatic: At Zhenzhou Zhao Yanshou declared himself acting administrator of state affairs.

units.zh: 辛巳，陜州節度使趙暉加檢校太尉，華州節度使兼陜州馬步軍都指揮使侯章加檢校太傅，以陜府馬步軍副都指揮使兼絳州防禦使王晏為晉州節度使、檢校太傅，以丹州都指揮使、權知軍州事高彥珣為丹州刺史。
units.literal: On the day xinsi Zhao Hui, military governor of Shaanzhou, was promoted to Acting Grand Marshal; Hou Zhang, military governor of Huazhou and Commander-in-Chief of Shaanzhou's cavalry and infantry, was promoted to Acting Grand Tutor; Wang Yan, vice commander of Shaan prefecture's horse and foot and Defender of Jiangzhou, was made military governor of Jinzhou and Acting Grand Tutor; and Gao Yanqi, commander of Danzhou and acting administrator of military and prefectural affairs, was made Prefect of Danzhou.
units.idiomatic: On xinsi Zhao Hui was made Acting Grand Marshal, Hou Zhang Acting Grand Tutor, Wang Yan military governor of Jinzhou and Acting Grand Tutor, and Gao Yanqi prefect of Danzhou.

title.zh: 卷139 齊紀五
title.raw: 卷139 齊紀五

units.zh: 資治通鑑 第139卷
units.literal: Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Governance, Volume 139
units.idiomatic: Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Governance, Volume 139

units.zh: 【齊紀五】 閼逢閹茂，一年。
units.literal: [Qi Records 5] Eyan cycle, Emao year, one year.
units.idiomatic: [Qi Records 5] The Emao year of the Eyan cycle, year one.

units.zh: 高宗明皇帝上建武元年（
units.literal: First year of Jianwu of Emperor Ming the High Ancestor, upper fascicle (
units.idiomatic: The first year of Jianwu under Emperor Ming the High Ancestor (upper fascicle) (

units.zh: 壬戌，魏主北巡。
units.literal: On day renxu, the Wei emperor toured the north.
units.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the Wei emperor made a northern tour.

units.zh: 西昌侯鸞既誅徐龍駒、周奉叔，而尼媼外入者，頗傳異語。
units.literal: After Luan, Marquis of Xichang, had executed Xu Longju and Zhou Fengshu, nuns and old women entering from outside rather widely spread strange talk.
units.idiomatic: After Luan, Marquis of Xichang, had killed Xu Longju and Zhou Fengshu, nuns and old women coming in from outside spread all manner of alarming rumors.

units.zh: 中書令何胤，以後之從叔，為帝所親，使直殿省。
units.literal: Director of the Secretariat He Yin, being a paternal uncle on the empress's side, was intimate with the emperor and was made to attend the Hall Directorate.
units.idiomatic: He Yin, Director of the Secretariat, was a maternal uncle of the empress and a favorite of the emperor, who had him serve in the Hall Directorate.

units.zh: 乃謀出鸞於西州，中敕用事，不復關咨於鸞。
units.literal: Then they plotted to send Luan out to Western Province; central edicts would govern affairs, no longer consulting Luan.
units.idiomatic: They then planned to post Luan away to Western Province so that central orders would govern affairs without consulting him.

units.zh: 是時，蕭諶、蕭坦之握兵權，左僕射王晏總尚書事。
units.literal: At this time Chen and Tanzhi held military authority; Left Vice-Director of the Secretariat Wang Yan oversaw Masters of Writing affairs.
units.idiomatic: At this time Chen and Tanzhi controlled the army, while Wang Yan, Left Vice-Director of the Secretariat, oversaw the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 諶密召諸王典簽，約語之，不許諸王外接人物。
units.literal: Chen secretly summoned the palace stewards of the princes, made agreements with them, not permitting the princes to receive people from outside.
units.idiomatic: Chen secretly summoned each prince's chief clerk, bound them by agreement, and forbade the princes to receive outsiders.

units.zh: 諶親要日久，眾皆憚而從之。
units.literal: Chen had been intimate and influential for many days; all feared him and obeyed.
units.idiomatic: Chen had long been close to power, and everyone feared him and complied.

units.zh: 鸞以其謀告王晏，晏聞之，響應；
units.literal: Luan reported his plot to Wang Yan; Yan on hearing it responded in agreement;
units.idiomatic: Luan disclosed his plan to Wang Yan, who at once assented;

units.zh: 又告丹陽尹徐孝嗣，孝嗣亦從之。
units.literal: He also told Xu Xiaosi, governor of Danyang; Xiaosi also followed.
units.idiomatic: He also informed Xu Xiaosi, governor of Danyang, and Xiaosi went along as well.

units.zh: 孝嗣心然之，而不能從。
units.literal: Xiaosi inwardly agreed but could not refuse to follow.
units.idiomatic: Xiaosi agreed in his heart but could not bring himself to refuse.

units.zh: 帝謂蕭坦之曰：「人言鎮軍與王晏、蕭諶欲共廢我，似非虛傳。
units.literal: The emperor said to Tanzhi: "People say the General Who Guards the Army with Wang Yan and Xiao Chen together wish to depose me— it does not seem a false rumor.
units.idiomatic: The emperor said to Tanzhi: "People say the General Who Guards the Army, Wang Yan, and Chen are plotting to depose me together. That does not sound like idle talk.

units.zh: 卿所聞雲何？」
units.literal: What have you heard?"
units.idiomatic: What have you heard on your side?"

units.zh: 鸞引兵自尚書入雲龍門，戎服加朱衣於上，比入門，三失履。
units.literal: Luan led troops from the Masters of Writing into the Cloud Dragon Gate, military dress with vermilion robe over it; by the time he entered the gate he had lost his shoes three times.
units.idiomatic: Luan led his troops from the Masters of Writing compound through the Cloud Dragon Gate, wearing armor with a vermilion robe over it; before he crossed the threshold he lost his shoes three times.

units.zh: 王晏、徐孝嗣、蕭坦之、陳顯達、王廣之、沈文季皆隨其後。
units.literal: Wang Yan, Xu Xiaosi, Tanzhi, Chen Xianda, Wang Guangzhi, and Shen Wenji all followed behind him.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan, Xu Xiaosi, Tanzhi, Chen Xianda, Wang Guangzhi, and Shen Wenji all followed in his train.

units.zh: 帝在壽昌殿。
units.literal: The emperor was in the Shouchang Hall.
units.idiomatic: The emperor was in the Hall of Longevity and Prosperity.

units.zh: 八月，甲辰，以司空王敬則為太尉。
units.literal: Eighth month, jiachen, Wang Jingze, Minister of Works, was made Grand Commandant.
units.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiachen day, Wang Jingze, Minister of Works, was appointed Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 鄱陽王鏘為司徒，車騎大將軍陳顯達為司空，尚書左僕射王晏為尚書令。
units.literal: Xiao Qiang, Prince of Poyang, was made Minister of Education; Chen Xianda, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, was made Minister of Works; Wang Yan, Left Vice-Director of the Secretariat, was made Director of the Secretariat.
units.idiomatic: Xiao Qiang, Prince of Poyang, became Minister of Education; Chen Xianda, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, became Minister of Works; and Wang Yan, Left Vice-Director of the Secretariat, became Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 魏主至陰山。
units.literal: The Wei emperor reached Yin Mountain.
units.idiomatic: The Wei emperor reached Yin Mountain.

units.zh: 癸亥，高宗即皇帝位，大赦，改元。
units.literal: On day guihai, the High Ancestor assumed the imperial position, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name.
units.idiomatic: On guihai Emperor Ming took the throne, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the reign title.

units.zh: 以太尉王敬則為大司馬，司空陳顯達為太尉，尚書令王晏加驃騎大將軍，左僕射徐孝嗣加中軍大將軍，中領軍蕭諶為領軍將軍。
units.literal: Grand Commandant Wang Jingze was made Grand Marshal; Minister of Works Chen Xianda was made Grand Commandant; Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Yan was added as Rapid Cavalry Grand General; Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Xu Xiaosi was added as General of the Central Army; Central Palace Guard Commander Xiao Zhen was made Commander of the Palace Guards.
units.idiomatic: Wang Jingze was made Grand Marshal, Chen Xianda Grand Commandant, Wang Yan Rapid Cavalry Grand General, Xu Xiaosi General of the Central Army, and Xiao Zhen Commander of the Palace Guards.

units.zh: 度支尚書虞悰稱疾不陪位。
units.literal: Minister of Revenue Yu Song claimed illness and did not attend the enthronement.
units.idiomatic: Yu Song, Minister of Revenue, pleaded illness and did not attend the enthronement.

units.zh: 帝以悰舊人，欲引參佐命，使王晏繼廢立事示悰。
units.literal: The emperor, because Song was an old acquaintance, wished to draw him in to assist the mandate; he had Wang Yan continue the account of deposition and enthronement to show Song.
units.idiomatic: The emperor, knowing Song as an old associate, wished to enlist him in the new order and had Wang Yan recount the deposition and enthronement for his benefit.

units.zh: 悰曰：「主上聖明，公卿戮力，寧假朽老以贊惟新乎！
units.literal: Song said: "The ruler above is sagely and bright, the dukes and ministers exert their strength together—how could one borrow a decayed old man to assist the renewal!
units.idiomatic: Song said: "Your Majesty is sage and brilliant, and the ministers serve with one accord—why borrow a worn-out old man for the renewal of the state!

units.zh: 帝與群臣宴會，詔功臣上酒。
units.literal: emperor with ministers banquet, ordered meritorious ministers offer wine.
units.idiomatic: The emperor feasted with his ministers and ordered meritorious officials to offer toasts.

units.zh: 王晏等興席，謝瀹獨不起，曰：「陛下受命，應天順人；
units.literal: Wang Yan and others rose from seats, Xie Yue alone did not rise, said: "Your Majesty received Mandate, responded to Heaven followed people;
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan and the others rose from their seats; Xie Yue alone remained seated and said, "Your Majesty received the Mandate, harmonizing with Heaven and following the people;

units.zh: 王晏妄叨天功以為己力！」
units.literal: Wang Yan presumptuously usurps Heaven's merit as his own strength!"
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan presumptuously claims Heaven's merit as his own achievement!"

units.zh: 帝大笑，解之。
units.literal: emperor great laugh, excused him.
units.idiomatic: The emperor laughed heartily and let the matter pass.

title.zh: 卷二十二 本紀第二十二: 道宗二
title.raw: 卷二十二 本紀第二十二: 道宗二 Volume 22 Annals 22: Daozong 2

units.zh: 道宗二
units.literal: Daozong, Part Two
units.idiomatic: Daozong, Part Two

units.zh: 八年春正月癸丑，如鴨子河。
units.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on guichou day, went to the Duck River.
units.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on guichou day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.

units.zh: 二月，駐蹕納葛濼。
units.literal: Second month, halted at Nage Marsh.
units.idiomatic: In the second month the court halted at Nage Marsh.

units.zh: 秋七月丙辰，如太子山。
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingchen day, went to Crown Prince Mountain.
units.idiomatic: On bingchen day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Crown Prince Mountain.

units.zh: 戊午，皇太叔重元與其子楚國王涅魯古及陳國王陳六、同知北院樞密使事蕭胡睹、衛王貼不、林牙涅剌溥古、統軍使蕭叠裏得、駙馬都尉參及弟術者、圖骨、旗鼓拽剌詳穩耶律郭九、文班太保奚叔、內藏提點烏骨、護衛左太保敵不古、按答、副宮使韓家奴、寶神奴等凡四百人，誘脅弩手軍犯行宮。
units.literal: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.
units.idiomatic: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.

units.zh: 時南院樞密使許王仁先、知北樞密院事趙王耶律乙辛、南府宰相蕭唐古、北院宣徽使蕭韓家奴、北院樞密副使蕭惟信、敦睦宮使耶律良等率宿衛士卒數千人禦之。
units.literal: At the time Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Xu Renxian, Yelü Yixin who administered Northern Privy Council affairs, Southern Court chancellor Xiao Tanggu, Northern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hanjianu, Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin, Dunmu Palace commissioner Yelü Liang, and others led several thousand night-guard troops to resist.
units.idiomatic: At the time Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Xu Renxian, Yelü Yixin who administered Northern Privy Council affairs, Southern Court chancellor Xiao Tanggu, Northern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hanjianu, Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin, Dunmu Palace commissioner Yelü Liang, and others led several thousand night-guard troops to resist.

units.zh: 二年春正月丁巳，如鴨子河。
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on dingsi day, went to the Duck River.
units.idiomatic: In the second year, on dingsi day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.

units.zh: 宋賀正使王嚴卒，以禮送還。
units.literal: Song envoy congratulating the New Year Wang Yan died; he was sent back with full rites.
units.idiomatic: Song envoy congratulating the New Year Wang Yan died; he was sent back with full rites.

units.zh: 癸未，幸山榆澱。
units.literal: On guiwei day visited Shanyu Marsh.
units.idiomatic: On guiwei day the court visited Shanyu Marsh.

title.raw: 卷二百四十三 列傳第二 后妃下 Volume 243 Biographies 2: Empresses and Consorts 2

units.zh: 神宗欽聖獻肅向皇后、欽成朱皇后、欽慈陳皇后、林賢妃、武賢妃 哲宗昭慈孟皇后、昭懷劉皇后 徽宗顯恭王皇后、鄭皇后、王貴妃、韋賢妃、喬貴妃、劉貴妃 欽宗朱皇后 高宗憲節邢皇后、憲聖慈烈吳皇后、潘賢妃、張賢妃、劉貴妃、劉婉儀、張貴妃 孝宗成穆郭皇后、成恭夏皇后、成肅謝皇后、蔡貴妃、李賢妃 光宗慈懿李皇后、黃貴妃 甯宗恭淑韓皇后、恭聖仁烈楊皇后 理宗謝皇后 度宗全皇后、楊淑妃
units.literal: Under Emperor Shenzong: Empress Qinxian Xiansu Xiang, Empress Qincheng Zhu, Empress Qinci Chen, Worthy Consort Lin, Worthy Consort Wu. Under Emperor Zhezong: Empress Zhaoci Meng, Empress Zhaohuai Liu. Under Emperor Huizong: Empress Xiangong Wang, Empress Zheng, Imperial Noble Consort Wang, Worthy Consort Wei, Worthy Consort Qiao, Imperial Consort Liu. Under Emperor Qinzong: Empress Zhu. Under Emperor Gaozong: Empress Xianjie Xing, Empress Xiansheng Cilie Wu, Worthy Consort Pan, Worthy Consort Zhang, Imperial Consort Liu, Honored Lady Liu, Imperial Noble Consort Zhang. Under Emperor Xiaozong: Empress Chengmu Guo, Empress Chenggong Xia, Empress Chengsu Xie, Imperial Consort Cai, Worthy Consort Li. Under Emperor Guangzong: Empress Ciyi Li, Imperial Consort Huang. Under Emperor Ningzong: Empress Gongshu Han, Empress Gongsheng Renlie Yang. Under Emperor Lizong: Empress Xie. Under Emperor Duzong: Empress Quan, Imperial Concubine Yang Shu.
units.idiomatic: The empresses and consorts treated in this volume are: for Shenzong, Empress Qinxian Xiansu Xiang, Empress Qincheng Zhu, Empress Qinci Chen, and the Worthy Consorts Lin and Wu; for Zhezong, Empress Zhaoci Meng and Empress Zhaohuai Liu; for Huizong, Empress Xiangong Wang, Empress Zheng, Imperial Noble Consort Wang, and the Worthy Consorts Wei and Qiao, together with Imperial Consort Liu; for Qinzong, Empress Zhu; for Gaozong, Empress Xianjie Xing, Empress Xiansheng Cilie Wu, the Worthy Consorts Pan and Zhang, Imperial Consort Liu, Honored Lady Liu, and Imperial Noble Consort Zhang; for Xiaozong, Empresses Chengmu Guo, Chenggong Xia, and Chengsu Xie, Imperial Consort Cai, and Worthy Consort Li; for Guangzong, Empress Ciyi Li and Imperial Consort Huang; for Ningzong, Empress Gongshu Han and Empress Gongsheng Renlie Yang; for Lizong, Empress Xie; and for Duzong, Empress Quan and Imperial Concubine Yang Shu.

units.zh: 欽聖獻肅向皇后
units.literal: Empress Qinxian Xiansu Xiang
units.idiomatic: Empress Qinxian Xiansu Xiang

units.zh: 神宗欽聖憲肅向皇后，河內人，故宰相敏中曾孫也。
units.literal: Empress Qinxian Xiansu Xiang of Emperor Shenzong was a native of Henei and a great-granddaughter of the former chief councilor Minzhong.
units.idiomatic: Empress Qinxian Xiansu Xiang, consort of Emperor Shenzong, came from Henei and was a great-granddaughter of the former chief councilor Minzhong.

units.zh: 六月朔，日食既，太后削「聖福」以應天變。
units.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, at the completion of a solar eclipse, the empress dowager removed "Shengfu" from her title to respond to the heavenly omen.
units.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, when a solar eclipse reached totality, the empress dowager dropped "Shengfu" from her title to answer the heavenly warning.

units.zh: 丞相王爚老病，陳宜中、留夢炎庸懦無所長，日坐朝堂相爭戾。
units.literal: Chief Councilor Wang Yan was old and ill; Chen Yizhong and Liu Mengyan were mediocre, timid, and without special ability; day after day they sat in court quarreling bitterly.
units.idiomatic: Chief Councilor Wang Yan was old and ill. Chen Yizhong and Liu Mengyan were mediocre and timid men of no special talent, and day after day they quarreled in court.

units.zh: 而張世傑兵敗于焦山，宜中棄官去。
units.literal: Meanwhile Zhang Shijie's army was defeated at Jiaoshan and Yizhong abandoned his office and fled.
units.idiomatic: Zhang Shijie's army was defeated at Jiaoshan, and Yizhong abandoned his post and fled.

title.zh: 卷二十一 列傳第十一 王弘
title.raw: 卷二十一 列傳第十一 王弘 Volume 21 Biographies 11: Wang Hong

units.zh: 王弘，字休元，琅邪临沂人也。
units.literal: Wang Hong, styled Xiuyuan, was a man of Langya Linyi.
units.idiomatic: Wang Hong, courtesy name Xiuyuan, came from Langya commandery, Linyi county.

units.zh: 曾祖导，晋丞相，祖洽，中领军，父珣，司徒。
units.literal: His great-grandfather Dao was Chancellor of Jin; his grandfather Qia was Central Army Commander; his father Xun was Minister of Education.
units.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Dao had served as Chancellor of Jin; his grandfather Qia as Central Army Commander; his father Xun as Minister of Education.

units.zh: 弘少好學，以清悟知名。
units.literal: Hong from youth loved learning and was famed for lucid insight.
units.idiomatic: From boyhood Hong loved study and won renown for clear, penetrating mind.

units.zh: 及長，折節修士操，涉獵書記，善碁工射。
units.literal: When grown he restrained himself and cultivated the conduct of a gentleman, broadly read records and documents, and was skilled at chess and archery.
units.idiomatic: When grown he checked himself and cultivated a gentleman's conduct, read widely, and excelled at chess and archery.

units.zh: 歷位驃騎將軍王晏長史。
units.literal: He served in succession as chief clerk to the Cavalry General Wang Yan.
units.idiomatic: He served in succession as chief clerk to the Cavalry General Wang Yan.

units.zh: 晏誅，出為晉陵太守。
units.literal: When Yan was executed he went out as Administrator of Jinling.
units.idiomatic: When Yan was executed he was sent out as Administrator of Jinling.

units.zh: 潔己為政，妻子不免饑寒，時號廉平。
units.literal: He kept himself clean in governance; wife and children did not escape hunger and cold; men of the time called him incorrupt and fair.
units.idiomatic: He governed cleanly; wife and children still knew hunger and cold; men called him incorrupt and fair.

title.en: Volume 252 Biographies 11: Wang Jing, Wang Yan, Guo Congyi, Li Hongxin, Wu Xingde, Yang Chengxin, Hou Zhang
title.raw: 卷二百五十二 列傳第十一 王景 王晏 郭從義 李洪信 武行德 楊承信 侯章 Volume 252 Biographies 11: Wang Jing, Wang Yan, Guo Congyi, Li Hongxin, Wu Xingde, Yang Chengxin, Hou Zhang

units.zh: 王景，萊州掖人，家世力田。
units.literal: Wang Jing was a native of Ye in Laizhou; his family for generations tilled the fields.
units.idiomatic: Wang Jing came from Ye in Laizhou. His family had farmed the land for generations.

units.zh: 景少倜儻，善騎射，不事生業，結里中惡少為群盜。
units.literal: When young, Jing was bold and unconventional, skilled at mounted archery, did not pursue a livelihood, and joined local ruffians as a band of robbers.
units.idiomatic: In youth he was daring and free-spirited, an excellent horseman and archer who shunned honest work and banded with neighborhood troublemakers as outlaws.

units.zh: 梁大將王檀鎮滑臺，以景隸麾下，與後唐莊宗戰河上，檀有功，景嘗左右之。
units.literal: The Liang general Wang Tan garrisoned Huatai and placed Jing under his command; when fighting Later Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong on the Yellow River, Tan won merit and Jing often assisted at his side.
units.idiomatic: Liang general Wang Tan held Huatai and took Jing into his service. In the river battles against Later Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong, Tan earned distinction, and Jing was often at his side.

units.zh: 聞者咸笑之，因目為『王當代』。
units.literal: Hearers all laughed at this, and so he was nicknamed "Wang the Successor."
units.idiomatic: Everyone who heard it laughed, and people nicknamed him "Wang the Successor."

units.zh: 王晏，徐州滕人，家世力田。
units.literal: Wang Yan was a native of Teng in Xuzhou; his family for generations tilled the fields.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan came from Teng in Xuzhou. His family had farmed for generations.

units.zh: 晏少壯勇無賴，嘗率群寇行攻劫。
units.literal: When young Yan was bold, fierce, and unruly; he once led a band of robbers in raids and plunder.
units.idiomatic: In youth Yan was fierce and lawless and led gangs in robbery and pillage.

units.zh: 行德率部民萬餘完其城，封邢國公。
units.literal: Xingde led more than ten thousand local people to complete the city and was enfeoffed as Duke of Xing.
units.idiomatic: Xingde led more than ten thousand local people to complete the walls and was enfeoffed as Duke of Xing.

units.zh: 是秋，代王晏為武寧軍節度，與晏兩換其任。
units.literal: That autumn he replaced Wang Yan as military governor of the Wuning army, the two exchanging their posts.
units.idiomatic: That autumn he and Wang Yan exchanged posts, Xingde taking the Wuning governorship.

units.zh: 先是，唐末楊氏據淮甸，自甬橋東南決汴，匯為汙澤。
units.literal: Earlier, late in Tang the Yang clan held the Huai region; from Yongqiao southeast they breached the Bian River, which pooled into a foul marsh.
units.idiomatic: Earlier, late in Tang the Yang clan held the Huai region. Southeast of Yongqiao they breached the Bian River, turning it into a foul marsh.

units.zh: 晉開運末，為忠衛指揮使，屯兵陜州，為內外馬步軍都指揮使兼三城巡檢使。
units.literal: At the end of Jin Kaiyun he was commander of the Loyal Guard, garrisoned troops at Shaanzhou, and served as overall commander of the inner and outer horse and foot armies, concurrently patrol commissioner of the three cities.
units.idiomatic: Late in the Jin Kaiyun reign he commanded the Loyal Guard at Shaanzhou and served as overall commander of the inner and outer armies and patrol commissioner of the three cities.

units.zh: 會契丹入中原，與趙暉、王晏謀斬契丹將劉愿，送款於漢祖。
units.literal: When the Khitan entered the central plains, together with Zhao Hui and Wang Yan he plotted to behead the Khitan general Liu Yuan and sent allegiance to the Han founding emperor.
units.idiomatic: When the Khitan overran the central plains, he joined Zhao Hui and Wang Yan in killing the Khitan general Liu Yuan and submitting to the Han emperor.

units.zh: 漢祖入汴，擢為鎮國軍節度。
units.literal: When the Han founding emperor entered Bian, Zhang was promoted to military governor of Zhenguo.
units.idiomatic: When the Han emperor entered Bian, Zhang was made military governor of Zhenguo.

units.zh: 景趨利改圖，乃至滅族。
units.literal: Jing, pursuing profit, changed his course, even to the extermination of his clan.
units.idiomatic: Yet Jing, chasing profit, changed course—and brought his clan to ruin.

units.zh: 王晏、郭從義遷怒肆忿，誣人以死。
units.literal: Wang Yan and Guo Congyi shifted anger and vented wrath, framing men to death.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan and Guo Congyi vented their rage on others and framed innocent men to death.

units.zh: 侯章在藩邸有剝下之名，李洪義狃於肺腑之戚，而無外凜之志，咎孰甚焉！
units.literal: Hou Zhang had a reputation at his regional command for stripping subordinates; Li Hongyi was accustomed to kinship of flesh and blood yet lacked outward awe-inspiring resolve—whose fault was the greater!
units.idiomatic: Hou Zhang was known for exploiting his subjects. Li Hongyi rested on family ties and lacked the outward sternness a commander needs—who was more to blame?

units.zh: 列傳第五十
units.literal: Biographies, number fifty.
units.idiomatic: the 50th year of Biographies

units.zh: 范岫傅昭孔休源江革徐勉許懋殷鈞
units.literal: Fan Xia, Fu Zhao, Kong Xiuyuan, Jiang Ge, Xu Mian, Xu Mao, Yin Jun.
units.idiomatic: Fan Xia, Fu Zhao, Kong Xiuyuan, Jiang Ge, Xu Mian, Xu Mao, and Yin Jun

units.zh: 高祖宣，晉徵士。
units.literal: His great-great-grandfather Xuan was a summoned scholar under Jin.
units.idiomatic: His great-great-grandfather Xuan had been a summoned scholar under Jin.

units.zh: 昭明太子尚幼，敕知宮事，太子禮之甚重，每事詢謀。
units.literal: Crown Prince Zhaoming was still young; by edict Mian was ordered to manage palace affairs. The crown prince honored him greatly and consulted him on every matter.
units.idiomatic: Crown Prince Zhaoming was still young. By edict Mian was ordered to manage palace affairs. The crown prince honored him greatly and consulted him on every matter.

units.zh: 嘗於殿講孝經，臨川王宏、尚書令沈約備二傅，勉與國子祭酒張充為執經，王瑩、張稷、柳憕、王暕為侍講。
units.literal: Once in the hall he lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety. Prince Linchuan Hong and Director of the Imperial Secretariat Shen Yue served as the two mentors; Mian and Chancellor of the Imperial University Zhang Chong held the classic; Wang Ying, Zhang Ji, Liu Zong, and Wang Yan served as lecture attendants.
units.idiomatic: Once in the hall he lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety. Prince Linchuan Hong and Director of the Imperial Secretariat Shen Yue served as the two mentors; Mian and Chancellor of the Imperial University Zhang Chong held the classic; Wang Ying, Zhang Ji, Liu Zong, and Wang Yan served as lecture attendants.

units.zh: 時選極親賢，妙盡人譽。
units.literal: The selection at the time was of the closest kin and worthiest men, wonderfully exhausting human praise.
units.idiomatic: The selection at the time drew on the closest kin and worthiest men, winning universal praise.

title.en: Volume 33 Biographies 14: Wang Sengqian, Zhang Xu
title.raw: 卷三十三 列傳第十四 王僧虔 張緒 Volume 33 Biographies 14: Wang Sengqian, Zhang Xu

units.zh: 南齊書卷三十三‧列傳第十四
units.literal: Book of the Southern Qi, Volume 33 — Biography 14
units.idiomatic: Book of the Southern Qi, Volume 33 — Biography 14

units.zh: 王僧虔 張緒
units.literal: Wang Sengqian; Zhang Xu
units.idiomatic: Wang Sengqian; Zhang Xu

units.zh: 王僧虔，琅邪臨沂人也。
units.literal: Wang Sengqian was a native of Linyi in Langye.
units.idiomatic: Wang Sengqian was a man of Linyi in Langye.

units.zh: 晃遣書佐固請之，緒正色謂晃信曰：「此是身家州郷，殿下何得見逼！」
units.literal: Huang sent a clerk to request it insistently; Xu, with stern expression, told Huang's messenger, "This is the province and village of my own person and household. How can Your Highness press me so?"
units.idiomatic: Huang sent a clerk to press the request. Xu faced Huang's messenger sternly and said, "This is my own home province and village. How can Your Highness force me in this?"
